## Summary

On current `main` (6ec0512, released as 2026.10.15) the publish-attestation verifier refuses two fleet workflows that contain no unproven publish. Both repositories pin pm-ops 2026.10.6, where they pass, so the next Dependabot pm-ops bump will fail their `verify:release-publish-attestation` test.

| Repository | File | Construct | Verdict on main |
|---|---|---|---|
| pm-changelog | `.github/workflows/release.yml:110` | `if [[ "$current_version" =~ ^([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)(-[0-9]+)?$ ]]; then` | `cannot prove executable expansion; refusing an unresolved publish path: ?$ ]]` |
| pm-github | `.github/workflows/pm-github-sync.yml:80` | `[[ "${PM_GITHUB_VERSION}" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(-[0-9]+)?$ ]] \|\| { …; exit 1; }` | same |
| pm-github | `.github/workflows/pm-github-sync.yml:131` | `sync_scope=(":(top,literal)${PM_SYNC_TRACKER}" ':(top,literal)CHANGELOG.md' …)` | `… unresolved publish path: :(top,literal)${PM_SYNC_TRACKER} …` |

## How this was measured

The verifier from 6ec0512 (`dist/attestation.js`, `verify(root)` + `report`) was run against every fleet checkout that has a `release.yml`, then compared with the candidate in #171. #171 changes no verdict except fixing pm-review, so these two are pre-existing and separate from #170.

## Expected

- The right-hand side of `=~` inside `[[ … ]]` is a regular expression operand. Its `(`, `)`, `?` and trailing `$` are not substitutions, subshells or expansions in command position.
- An array assignment `name=( … )` holds words, not a command. Quoted elements containing `(`/`)` stay inside their quotes.
- The refusal has to keep failing closed when a `[[ … ]]` operand or an array element really hides `$(npm publish)` or a backtick publish. That needs adversarial tests in both directions, as #170 required.

Found while verifying #171 for the 2026-10-15 fleet session.
